column1: # DISCLAIMER: Educational purposes ONLY. Do not use without authorization.
# This demonstrates a staged DDE approach where Stage 1 is a minimal downloader.
#   - Minimal DDE formula that only downloads Stage 2
#   - Smaller footprint than full payload = less detection surface
#   - DDE formula: triggers PowerShell to download stage 2
# Stage 1 only downloads a file - fewer behavioral indicators than full payload
# Stage 2 can be updated server-side without resending Stage 1
# Harder for sandboxes to fully analyze the complete chain
# - Downloaded file execution from TEMP directory
# - Block outbound connections from Office processes
# - Monitor for PowerShell spawned from Office applications
